_about: Stage definitions for the evaluation (see eval/README.md). Stages are cumulative: each extends the one before and switches on one human-in-the-loop iteration. To try a teacher-requested refinement, add a new stage that extends the one being refined (e.g. "S3-v2": {"extends": "S3", ...}) and change fragments, extraRules, flags or snapshot; then run it and compare. Later stages can be re-pointed at an accepted refinement by changing their "extends".

S0.label: Basic RAG database and original prompt
S0.note: Original prompt with basic retrieval: similar rule cards + correction exemplars. End-of-story content check without the teacher's scene list.

S1.label: + Critique of AI feedback
S1.note: Teacher's 'My comment' critiques: rules 1-8, pinned ai_error_cards, structured output format.

S2.label: + Required-scene list
S2.note: End-of-story content check against the teacher's scene_list; per-scene rule 9 (no plot comments per scene).

S3.label: + Vocabulary error list
S3.note: Wrong words (用错的词) are errors under Grammar Corrections; vocab_error entries retrieved by regex triggers + similarity.

S4.label: + Coherence rules
S4.note: Coherence rules A-C, Coherence & Expressiveness section, pinned reference/了 rule cards, earlier scenes and model story as context. = production.

S1-v2.label: + Critique of AI feedback (relabelled)
S1-v2.note: Same as S1, but the AI-mistake cards are rebuilt from the new labels for all 67 critiqued AI items (no 'unclassified'), with examples chosen so more different critiques appear.

S1-v3.label: + Critique of AI feedback (relabelled, similar critiques retrieved)
S1-v3.note: S1-v2 plus, for each scene, the 3 critiqued AI items most similar to the scene (by embedding similarity), each with the teacher's verdict.

S5.label: + Vocabulary suggestion revision
S5.note: Teacher's comments on the S4 feedback: vocabulary suggestions only when clearly more appropriate in context (at most 3, none for acceptable words, never changing the meaning); the error section renamed Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections.

S5-v2.label: + Vocabulary suggestions guided by the teacher's examples
S5-v2.note: S5 with the teacher's official list of good vocabulary suggestions shown as models, and positive guidance: 1-3 suggestions per scene for correct but plain/general words, each checked in the student's sentence (same meaning, strength, collocation, tone).

S6.label: + Teacher's extra rules and definitions
S6.note: The teacher's 8 additional rules (extra rules.docx + general rules from her S5 comments) shown with the places they may apply; her 25 revised rule definitions on the rule cards; end-of-story feedback without scene numbers; vocabulary suggestions aimed at precision rather than formality.

S6-2pass.label: + Two-pass retrieval with structured output
S6-2pass.note: S6, but each scene runs in two passes: pass 1 lists candidate errors as JSON (span, category, rule); the teacher's rule card and labelled corrections are retrieved for each candidate; pass 2 writes the feedback as JSON. Every quoted span is checked against the student's text.

S6-r2.label: S6, repeat run (r2)
S6-r2.note: Identical to S6; a repeated run to measure run-to-run consistency (eval/v1_vs_v2).

S6-r3.label: S6, repeat run (r3)
S6-r3.note: Identical to S6; a repeated run to measure run-to-run consistency (eval/v1_vs_v2).

S5-r2.label: S5, repeat run (r2)
S5-r2.note: Identical to S5; a repeated run to measure run-to-run consistency (eval/v1_vs_v2).

S5-r3.label: S5, repeat run (r3)
S5-r3.note: Identical to S5; a repeated run to measure run-to-run consistency (eval/v1_vs_v2).

S6-h20.label: S6 on the 20-story test set
S6-h20.note: Baseline for S7: S6 unchanged (same flags and prompt), on base-v4's exact sources with the 20 stories of the alignment check held out, run on those 20 stories (eval/S7_plan.md).

S6-h20-r2.label: S6 on the 20-story test set, repeat run (r2)
S6-h20-r2.note: Identical to S6-h20; repeated run for run-to-run consistency.

S6-h20-r3.label: S6 on the 20-story test set, repeat run (r3)
S6-h20-r3.note: Identical to S6-h20; repeated run for run-to-run consistency.

S7-0.label: S7-0: S6 on her new feedback data (base-v5)
S7-0.note: No code or prompt change: S6 exactly, on base-v5 -- her exact training edits (whole-clause rule-card examples), 20 teacher rules (12 new; low-precision new triggers parked), her critique-label revisions on the pinned AI-error cards. Standard fixes, rule examples and the two new AI-error cards exist in base-v5 but are not shown until later stages. eval/S7_plan.md.

S7-0b.label: S7-0b: + her revised critique cards pinned
S7-0b.note: S7-0 plus the two AI-error cards built from her 15 Oct revisions (over-correction; wrong or missing explanation), pinned like S6's other eight. eval/S7_plan.md.

S7-1.label: S7-1: + reasoning effort medium
S7-1.note: The feedback model reasons at medium effort instead of low (S6 and earlier: low). One change from S7-0 (S7-0b was not accepted: no gain). No prompt or data change. eval/S7_plan.md.

S7-2.label: S7-2: + each correction names its rule; cards show her standard fix
S7-2.note: Every error item ends with [rule: name] / [teacher rule: id] / [vocab list] / [rule: none]; rule cards show her standard fix where she makes the same fix 2+ times (13 of 49 cards), to reuse instead of rewording. eval/S7_plan.md.

S7-3.label: S7-3: + end-of-story scene check (fixed verdict per required scene)
S7-3.note: For a retelling, the content check first lists every required scene with one verdict (told / partly told / missing / wrong), then writes one note per scene marked partly told / missing / wrong ('Missing scene: ...' / 'You need to ...'). Scene feedback unchanged. eval/S7_plan.md.

S7-4.label: S7-4: + rule-card regex triggers (cards chosen by the error, not only by similarity)
S7-4.note: base-v6 = base-v5 + provisional regex triggers on 5 rule cards (rule_card_triggers.json, measured on training stories). A matching trigger adds its rule card (marked with the places to check) and one past correction labelled with that rule. Similarity search and pinned cards unchanged. eval/S7_plan.md.

S0-h20.label: S0 on the 20-story test set (floor: no teacher input)
S0-h20.note: Floor reference for S7: the original prompt with basic retrieval only (no critique, rules, scene list, vocabulary list or coherence input), on the 20 stories. Snapshot base-v4-h20 (S0 originally used base-v2; S0 reads only basic-data chunks, built from the same sources).

S7-5.label: S7-5: + rule cards found through her corrected student sentences (per sentence)
S7-5.note: Each sentence of the scene is searched against the 920 rule_example chunks (student sentences she corrected, each linked to its rule card); the cards of the top 2 matches per sentence are added, at most 4 new cards per scene, each with the closest corrected sentence. Offline: card reach 43% -> 72%, +3.4 cards per scene. eval/S7_plan.md.

S7-6.label: S7-6: whole-scene similarity cards replaced by per-sentence matches on her corrected sentences
S7-6.note: Extends S7-4 (S7-5 rejected). The 4 rule cards from whole-scene similarity are replaced by the cards of the closest rule_example matches (top 2 per sentence, best first, up to 4 not already pinned or triggered); no example sentences shown. Same number of cards as S7-4. eval/S7_plan.md.
